## Description

Switching template or regenerating creates a new draft version; the doctor confirms because accepted/edited fields may be replaced (option to keep accepted fields). All clinician edits are tracked (field, before/after, time) for quality metrics (edit distance).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Regeneration requires confirmation and never discards accepted/edited fields without an explicit choice.
- [ ] **AC2.** Draft versions are kept and linked to AI runs.
- [ ] **AC3.** Edit distance per field is computed for the ≥ 80 % minor-edits metric (MDV-P3-026).

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
